chatSystem.label: AI Chat — System Prompt
chatSystem.description: System prompt for the in-editor AI Assistant chat. Variables: {collectionName}, {fieldDescriptions}

generateSystem.label: Generate Article — System Prompt
generateSystem.description: System prompt for full-article generation from collection list or editor. Variables: {brandVoice}, {schemaInstructions}

rewriteSystem.label: Rewrite — System Prompt
rewriteSystem.description: System prompt for the inline rewrite feature (bubble menu).

agentRunnerSchema.label: Agent Runner — Schema Instructions
agentRunnerSchema.description: Appended to every agent run. Tells the LLM how to format JSON output. Variables: {fieldList}

agentGeneratePrompt.label: Agent — Auto-Generate System Prompt
agentGeneratePrompt.description: Prompt used to auto-generate an agent's system prompt from role + name.

agentCreateFromDescription.label: Agent — Create from Description
agentCreateFromDescription.description: System prompt for generating a full agent config from a natural language description.

interactivesGenerate.label: Interactives — Create with AI
interactivesGenerate.description: System prompt for generating new standalone HTML interactives from a user description.

interactivesEdit.label: Interactives — Edit with AI
interactivesEdit.description: System prompt for modifying existing HTML interactives via chat. Variables: {title}, {interactiveId}

website.label: WebSite
website.description: Site-level schema with search action (use on homepage)

linkName.title: Links do not have discernible name
linkName.description: Add descriptive text to all <a> links in your content. Avoid empty links or links with only an icon.

colorContrast.title: Background/foreground contrast ratio
colorContrast.description: Adjust your site's CSS to ensure text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background. Use a contrast checker tool.

renderBlockingResources.title: Render-blocking resources
renderBlockingResources.description: Defer non-critical CSS/JS. For static sites, inline critical CSS. For Next.js, the framework handles this automatically.

unusedJavascript.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
unusedJavascript.description: Remove unused JS libraries or use dynamic imports. For Next.js, enable tree-shaking and code splitting.

usesResponsiveImages.title: Properly size images
usesResponsiveImages.description: Use the CMS image processing pipeline (F44) to generate responsive variants. Add width/height attributes to all images.

offscreenImages.title: Defer offscreen images
offscreenImages.description: Add loading="lazy" to images below the fold. The CMS build pipeline does this automatically for static sites.

largestContentfulPaint.title: Largest Contentful Paint
largestContentfulPaint.description: Optimize your largest visible element. Common fixes: compress hero image, use WebP, preload LCP image, reduce server response time.

cumulativeLayoutShift.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
cumulativeLayoutShift.description: Add explicit width/height to images and embeds. Avoid inserting content above existing content. Use font-display: swap.

firstContentfulPaint.title: First Contentful Paint
firstContentfulPaint.description: Reduce server response time, eliminate render-blocking resources, preload critical assets.

serverResponseTime.title: Server response time (TTFB)
serverResponseTime.description: Use a CDN, enable caching, optimize server-side rendering. For Fly.io, ensure the machine is in the closest region.

domSize.title: DOM size too large
domSize.description: Simplify your page structure. Lazy-load complex sections. Paginate long lists.

redirects.title: Avoid multiple page redirects
redirects.description: Update links to point directly to the final URL. Remove unnecessary redirect chains.

totalByteWeight.title: Total page size too large
totalByteWeight.description: Compress images, remove unused CSS/JS, enable gzip/brotli compression on your server.

documentTitle.title: Missing page titles
documentTitle.fixed: Added meta titles to {count} documents from their content title.

metaDescription.title: Missing meta descriptions
metaDescription.fixed: Added meta descriptions to {count} documents from excerpts.

hreflang.title: Missing hreflang
hreflang.oneLocale: Site has only one locale configured. Add additional locales in Site Settings → Language to enable hreflang.
hreflang.switched: Switched locale strategy from "none" to "prefix-other" — the build pipeline now generates hreflang tags automatically for {count} locales.
hreflang.configured: hreflang is configured ({locales} with "{strategy}" strategy). The build pipeline generates hreflang tags automatically.

htmlLang.title: HTML lang attribute
htmlLang.defaultSet: Default locale is set. The build pipeline adds lang attribute to <html> automatically.
htmlLang.configured: Default locale "{locale}" is configured. Build pipeline adds lang="{locale}" to <html>.

mainLandmark.title: Missing <main> landmark
mainLandmark.description: Wrap your page content in a <main> element. For Next.js: add <main> in layout.tsx. For static sites: the build pipeline template should use <main> around {content}. Check your build.ts or layout component.

imageAlt.missing: Found {count} images without alt text. Go to Media Library and run "Analyze All" to generate AI alt text, or edit individual documents.

fontDisplay.title: Font display
fontDisplay.description: Add font-display: swap to your @font-face declarations or Google Fonts URL (&display=swap). This prevents invisible text during font loading.

lighthouseRunner.localhost: Cannot audit localhost URLs — PSI API requires a public URL. Deploy your site first, then scan the production URL.

psiEngine.quotaExceeded: Daily quota exceeded — add your own PageSpeed Insights API key below to get 25,000 free scans per day.
psiEngine.invalidUrl: Invalid URL — make sure the site is publicly accessible (not localhost).
psiEngine.unavailable: Google PageSpeed Insights is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
psiEngine.error: PageSpeed Insights returned an error ({status}). Check that the URL is correct and the site is online.

imageAnalysis.noVisionKey: No vision API key configured. Add a Mistral or Gemini key in Cockpit → Settings.

imageGeneration.promptTooLong: Image generation prompt is too long (max 4000 characters)
imageGeneration.notSetUp: Image generation is not set up: BFL_API_KEY is missing.
imageGeneration.outsideEu: Image generation answered outside the EU (provider {provider}, region {region}); refused.
imageGeneration.notAnImage: Image download was not an image ({type})

formsStore.configFormNotEditable: Form "{name}" is defined in cms.config.ts and cannot be modified from the admin UI
formsStore.configFormNotDeletable: Form "{name}" is defined in cms.config.ts and cannot be deleted from the admin UI

podcastCommon.tooFewLines: only {count} line(s) — an episode is a conversation, not a monologue (at least {min})

podcastManuscript.noJsonList: the answer contains no JSON list
podcastManuscript.jsonUnreadable: the JSON list could not be read: {error}
podcastManuscript.notAList: the answer is not a list
podcastManuscript.unknownSpeaker: line {index} has the speaker «{speaker}» — only {hosts} exist
podcastManuscript.oneHostOnly: only «{speaker}» speaks — an episode with two hosts must have both

podcastState.illegalTransition: «{from}» cannot go to «{to}» — from here only {allowed} is allowed
podcastState.alreadyRecorded: the episode is already recorded — a new recording costs again. Edit the script first, and the approval falls away by itself.
podcastState.notApproved: the script is not approved (it is «{state}»). Recording costs real money, so it requires that a person has read the text.

podcastTextFormat.headerFormat: FORMAT: «AIDAN:» or «AIRINA:» on a line of its own, the line of dialogue below.
podcastTextFormat.headerIgnored: Empty lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
podcastTextFormat.headerNames: Do not change the names — only the two hosts exist.
podcastTextFormat.speakerNoText: line {line}: «{speaker}:» has no text below it
podcastTextFormat.notAHost: line {line}: «{speaker}» is not one of the hosts. Only {hosts} exist.
podcastTextFormat.textBeforeSpeaker: line {line}: there is text before the first speaker. Each line of dialogue must start with «AIDAN:» or «AIRINA:» on a line of its own.
podcastTextFormat.noLines: the file contains no lines of dialogue

podcastStore.missingCollection: Podcasts are not switched on for this site. Contact your administrator if you want to use them.
podcastStore.missingAfterWrite: the episode «{slug}» does not exist after the write

podcastSponsors.missingCollection: Sponsor spots are not switched on for this site. Contact your administrator if you want to use them.
podcastSponsors.missingAfterWrite: the spot «{slug}» does not exist after the write
podcastSponsors.noAudio: the spot has no audio yet
podcastSponsors.inUse: the spot is used in {count} episode(s): {episodes}. Remove it from them first, or pause it instead of deleting it.

podcastGenerate.withdrawApprovalFirst: the episode is «{state}» — withdraw the approval first (set the state to «{next}»). A rewrite without that would change the text under an approval that still stood.
podcastGenerate.articleTooShort: the article has only {count} characters of body text — too little for an episode

podcastRecord.paidButNotSaved: the audio was made (and paid for) but could not be saved: {error}. Try again — it costs again.
podcastRecord.sponsorNotFound: the sponsor spot «{slug}» does not exist
podcastRecord.sponsorAudioUnreadable: the sponsor spot's audio file could not be read ({url}). The spot points to a file that is not there.

podcastStitch.noPieces: there are no audio pieces to join
podcastStitch.pieceLengthUnknown: could not measure the length of the audio piece
podcastStitch.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg is missing on the server, and without it the audio pieces cannot be joined. Add it to the image (apt-get install ffmpeg) — a plain concatenation gives a file that looks whole and stalls at the joins.
podcastStitch.joinedLengthUnknown: the joined file could not be measured

podcastVoices.noKey: there is no ElevenLabs key on this site
podcastVoices.noVoices: the provider answered without a single voice

welcomeDashboard.title: Welcome to your Dashboard
welcomeDashboard.body: This is your command center. Content stats, recent activity, and quick actions — all at a glance.

welcomeContent.title: Your Content
welcomeContent.body: All your collections live here — pages, posts, and any custom content types you define in cms.config.ts.

welcomeChat.title: Chat with your site
welcomeChat.body: Generate pages, translate content, optimize SEO, or manage your entire site through natural conversation. 47 tools at your fingertips.

welcomeAgents.title: AI Agents
welcomeAgents.body: Automated workers that write, translate, optimize, and refresh your content on schedule. Set them up once, let them run.

welcomeMedia.title: Media Library
welcomeMedia.body: Upload images, videos, and files. AI automatically generates alt text, captions, and tags for every image.

welcomeTools.title: Tools & SEO
welcomeTools.body: SEO scoring, link checker, backup, AI analytics, and visibility dashboard — everything to keep your site healthy and findable.

welcomeDone.title: You're all set!
welcomeDone.body: Click any collection to start creating content. Need help? Open Chat and ask anything.

docTitle.title: Give it a title
docTitle.body: Every document starts with a title. It's used in navigation, SEO, and search across your site.

docEditor.title: Write your content
docEditor.body: Rich text with markdown, images, tables, and code blocks. Type / for slash commands or just start writing.

docActionBar.title: Save & publish
docActionBar.body: Save your document with ⌘S. Set status to Published when it's ready to go live. The SEO panel optimizes your meta automatically.

seoScore.metaTitleMissing: Meta title is missing. Write a title for search results ({min}-{max} characters).
seoScore.metaTitleShort: Meta title is too short ({len} characters). Add more words to reach {min}-{max} characters.
seoScore.metaTitleLong: Meta title is too long ({len} characters). Google cuts off after {max}. Shorten it.
seoScore.metaTitleGood: Meta title length is good ({len}/{max} characters)
seoScore.metaDescMissing: Meta description is missing. Write a description for search results ({min}-{max} characters).
seoScore.metaDescShort: Meta description is too short ({len} characters). Add {add} more characters to reach {min}.
seoScore.metaDescLong: Meta description is too long ({len} characters). Google cuts off after {max}. Remove {remove} characters.
seoScore.metaDescGood: Meta description length is good ({len}/{max} characters)
seoScore.keywordNotInTitle: Add the keyword "{keyword}" to the meta title field above.
seoScore.keywordNotInDesc: Add the keyword "{keyword}" to the meta description field above.
seoScore.contentTooThin: Content is only {wc} words. Write at least 300 words for search engines to index properly.
seoScore.contentShort: Content is {wc} words. Write {more} more words to reach 300 (recommended minimum).
seoScore.headingsGood: Content uses H2 headings for structure
seoScore.headingsMissing: Content has no H2 headings. Break up the text with ## subheadings.
seoScore.imgAltMissing: {missing} of {total} images are missing alt text. Edit each image and add a description.
seoScore.ogImageMissing: No social image set. Add an image in the "Social image (OG)" field above — it shows when someone shares this page on Facebook/LinkedIn.
seoScore.keywordNotInSlug: The keyword "{keyword}" is not in the URL slug ({slug}). Consider renaming the slug in Properties.
seoScore.internalLinksGood: Content links to other pages on the site
seoScore.internalLinksMissing: No internal links. Add links to other pages on your site (e.g. related posts) to improve SEO.
seoScore.titleMissing: Page has no title. Fill in the Title field at the top of the editor.
seoScore.readabilityEasy: Readability score is {score}/100 — easy to read
seoScore.readabilityMedium: Readability score is {score}/100 — consider shorter sentences and simpler words
seoScore.readabilityHard: Readability score is {score}/100 — text is very hard to read. Use shorter sentences and simpler words.
seoScore.titleDuplicate: Meta title "{title}" is used by {count} documents. Each page should have a unique title.
seoScore.titleUnique: Meta title is unique across all documents
seoScore.geoAnswerFirstPass: First 200 words contain a direct answer with facts
seoScore.geoAnswerFirstWarn: Opening is OK but could lead with a stronger factual answer. Add a number or statistic in the first paragraph.
seoScore.geoAnswerFirstFail: Opening doesn't provide a direct answer. Restructure so the first paragraph answers the page's main question.
seoScore.geoQuestionHeadersPass: {questions}/{total} headings are questions ({pct}% — AI platforms match these to user queries)
seoScore.geoQuestionHeadersWarn: Only {questions}/{total} headings are questions. Rephrase some H2s as questions (e.g. "How does X work?") — AI platforms match these to queries.
seoScore.geoStatisticsPass: Content includes specific statistics — AI platforms prefer citing data-backed claims
seoScore.geoStatisticsWarn: Content has numbers but no clear statistics. Add percentages, costs, or measurable data points.
seoScore.geoStatisticsFail: No statistics found. Add specific numbers, percentages, or data points — AI systems strongly prefer citable facts.
seoScore.geoCitationsPass: Content references external sources — adds credibility for AI citation
seoScore.geoCitationsWarn: No external sources cited. Add references to research, data sources, or authoritative sites to boost AI trust.
seoScore.geoFreshnessPass: Updated {days} days ago — AI platforms have strong recency bias
seoScore.geoFreshnessWarn: Updated {days} days ago. Content older than 90 days gets less AI citation. Refresh key facts.
seoScore.geoFreshnessFail: Updated {days} days ago. Stale content is rarely cited by AI. Update with current information.
seoScore.geoJsonLdPass: JSON-LD structured data is configured — helps AI systems understand page content
seoScore.geoJsonLdPartial: JSON-LD template selected but not fully configured. Fill in the fields to help AI understand this content.
seoScore.geoJsonLdMissing: No JSON-LD structured data. Select a template (Article, FAQ, HowTo) in the Advanced section to help AI categorize this content.
seoScore.geoAuthorPass: Author "{author}" attributed — builds E-E-A-T trust signals for AI
seoScore.geoAuthorMissing: No author attributed. Add an author name — AI platforms trust content with clear authorship (E-E-A-T).
seoScore.geoDepthPass: {wc} words — comprehensive enough for AI to cite as an authoritative source
seoScore.geoDepthWarn: {wc} words — add more depth (800+ words) for AI platforms to consider this an authoritative source
seoScore.geoDepthFail: Only {wc} words. AI platforms rarely cite thin content. Aim for 800+ words with comprehensive coverage.

podcastPreflight.noLines: there are no lines to record
podcastPreflight.ipaRows: {count} row(s) use IPA, which the provider rejects: {words}. Rewrite them as sound-alike aliases.
podcastPreflight.tooFewVoices: only {count} voice(s) selected — a conversation needs two
podcastPreflight.voicesNotChecked: not looked up with the provider yet
podcastPreflight.notApproved: the audio cannot be made until the script is approved
